title: IT Support Executive
description:
Location : Cochin
 



 Department: IT / Operations
 



 Reports to: IT Manager / IT Lead
 



 Employment type: Full\-time, on\-site
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an active, dependable IT Support Executive to handle day\-to\-day L1 technical support across our offices. The role combines hands\-on first\-level troubleshooting with strong coordination skills \- you'll be the first point of contact for users and the key link between our team and external software/hardware vendors. We also value working knowledge of AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, drafting, and day\-to\-day tasks. Clear communication, ownership, and consistent follow\-up are at the heart of this job.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide L1 (first\-level) IT support to end users for hardware, software, network, email, and login issues.
* Log, track, and resolve support tickets promptly; escalate to L2/L3 or vendors when needed.
* Coordinate with software and hardware vendors for issue resolution, installations, updates, licenses, and warranty/AMC support.
* Follow up persistently with vendors and internal teams until issues are fully closed — no loose ends.
* Set up and configure desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals for new and existing users.
* Support basic network connectivity, Wi\-Fi, and access\-related issues.
* Maintain accurate records of assets, tickets, vendor interactions, and resolutions.
* Communicate clearly with users on issue status, expected timelines, and resolutions.
* Assist with routine IT maintenance, backups, and system checks.
* Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar assistants) to research solutions, draft communications, and resolve issues faster.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Basic L1 troubleshooting knowledge: Windows OS, MS Office, email clients, common business applications, printers, and basic networking.
* Strong command of language and communication — able to explain technical points simply to non\-technical users.
* Good vendor coordination and follow\-up skills; able to chase issues to closure.
* Comfortable handling multiple requests and prioritizing without dropping tasks.
* Working knowledge of AI tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar) and how to apply them practically for support, troubleshooting, and documentation.



  





**Personal Attributes** 



* Active and proactive — takes initiative rather than waiting to be told.
* Honest and trustworthy — handles systems and data with integrity.
* Strong work ethic — committed, reliable, and focused; no slacking or shortcuts.
* Service\-minded — patient and approachable with users.
* Willing to work on\-site at the assigned location.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Diploma / Degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 0–3 years of experience in IT support / helpdesk (freshers with the right attitude and basics may apply).



  





**What We Offer** 



* A stable, on\-site role with clear responsibilities.
* Exposure to vendor management and end\-to\-end issue ownership.
* A team that values reliability, honesty, and clear communication.

title: Lab Technician
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Lab Technician
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 Lab technician to support end\-to\-end software, firmware and product testing and validation. Assists the Lab Lead with build\-out and design.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build, cable, configure, maintain and document lab systems, devices and test environments under the direction of the Lab Lead.
* Execute end\-to\-end software, firmware, configuration and product test plans and record clear, reproducible results.
* Support Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android plus enterprise AV endpoints, peripherals and infrastructure.
* Provision and reset devices using Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID and approved deployment procedures.
* Monitor device health, collect logs, reproduce reported defects and support technical troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Maintain lab inventory, asset labels, firmware and software baselines, test accounts, spares and configuration records.
* Assist with rack, room and bench build\-out, including connectivity checks and safe equipment handling.
* Raise defects with complete evidence, track retesting and help maintain test scripts, knowledge articles and operating procedures.
* Coordinate with engineering, vendors and support teams while following lab access, change and security controls.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Technical diploma, degree or relevant hands\-on experience in AV, IT, electronics or a related field.
* Practical troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to executing and documenting tests.
* Good written and verbal English communication and the ability to work effectively with distributed teams.
* Attention to detail, safe working practices, customer orientation and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to manage multiple test tasks, shifting priorities and repetitive validation activities accurately.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Hands\-on Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android deployment, configuration and lifecycle support.
* Enterprise AV systems installation, integration and troubleshooting, including cameras, microphones, speakers, displays, DSPs and control devices.
* Windows and Android device troubleshooting plus basic Microsoft 365 administration awareness.
* Microsoft Intune device management, Autopilot provisioning and Microsoft Entra ID fundamentals.
* Basic networking knowledge including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP and device connectivity.
* PowerShell fundamentals for device checks, log collection and repeatable tasks.
* Experience using monitoring and management platforms such as Teams Admin Center, Control Hub, Poly Lens or Neat Pulse.
* Ability to follow test plans, capture evidence and maintain accurate inventory and configuration documentation.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Azure Administration knowledge aligned to AZ\-104 concepts.
* Azure Monitor and Log Analytics exposure.
* Power Automate, Logic Apps or Microsoft Graph API familiarity.
* Python or scripting experience for test automation.
* ServiceNow incident, request and asset\-management experience.
* AV industry certification such as CTS or relevant Crestron training.
* Experience with secure print, smart lockers or workplace spaces technology.


**What We Look For**
* We’re looking for a dependable, curious and detail\-oriented technician who enjoys hands\-on testing, follows disciplined processes and communicates defects clearly.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on challenging projects and gain access to an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: You’ll have the tools and flexibility to make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: You’ll gain the insights, coaching and confidence to help build the leadership capabilities the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate - System Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Associate \- System Engineer to support the maintenance and reliability of our internal systems, servers, and infrastructure. This role is ideal for fresh graduates or early\-career professionals who want to build strong foundational knowledge in Linux systems, networking, infrastructure operations, and security practices.
 



 The selected candidate will work closely with senior engineers to maintain infrastructure stability and gradually gain exposure to cloud platforms, automation tools, and DevSecOps practices.
 



 This role provides a strong learning path towards Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, and DevSecOps roles within the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Assist in maintaining internal servers, systems, and infrastructure environments.
* Monitor system performance, services, and alerts to ensure high availability.
* Support routine system maintenance, patching, and updates.
* Assist in server setup, configuration, and troubleshooting under supervision.
* Monitor backup processes and verify successful backup operations.
* Review system logs and report anomalies or potential issues.
* Assist in maintaining infrastructure documentation and system configurations.
* Provide basic technical support related to infrastructure systems when required.
* Support troubleshooting of system and network issues alongside senior engineers.
* Participate in improving infrastructure reliability and operational processes.



  





**Requirements** 



* Basic understanding of
 **Linux operating systems**
* Basic knowledge of
 **networking concepts** 
 (IP, DNS, HTTP, firewalls)
* Familiarity with
 **system troubleshooting and command\-line usage**
* Basic understanding of computer systems and infrastructure concepts
* Interest in
 **cloud computing, infrastructure automation, and security**
* Basic scripting knowledge (Bash / Shell / Python – beginner level acceptable)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Willingness to learn and work in infrastructure and security domains
* Good communication and teamwork skills



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 2025 / 2026 Pass out \- Diploma / Degree / B.Tech in IT, Computer Science, or related field
 



 Exposure to Linux environments through projects or coursework
 



 Basic awareness of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
 



 Understanding of virtualization concepts
 



 Any relevant certifications or courses in Linux, Cloud, or Networking are a plus
 



 Any DevOps or Cloud fundamentals certification
 



  





**Benefits** 




**A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.**

title: Implementation/ Product Support Executive

title: Software Analyst 1
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

*SOTI Careers* 
*. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.”*
***Who We Are***
 At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best\-in\-class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out\-of\-the\-box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software. To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they have always been done.
   

  

***What We’re Looking For***
 The Customer Bug (Jira) Analysis Team is a team within SOTI's Executive Escalations team that consists of team members with intensive EMM (SOTI MobiControl) product knowledge, proven customer\-facing, troubleshooting and escalations experience. Also skilled with deep\-level analysis of JIRA tickets. The team’s main function is to thoroughly analyze, debug, and provide fixes or workarounds to incoming JIRA tickets before reaching the core development team. The contribution of this team will in turn result in high\-quality bug tickets that truly need code fixes and will also alleviate workloads from developers. Software Analyst is responsible for reviewing and troubleshooting JIRA tickets coming from various departments such as the Technical Support team, Professional Services, Pre\-Sales, etc. The role involves critical issue analysis and research, testing, and advanced\-level troubleshooting techniques. Code referral and fix suggestions are also needed to identify potential bugs and solutions, respectively.
   

  

***What’s in it for you?***
*The People* 
 \- From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry\-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.
   

  

*The Growth* 
 \- Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!
   

  

*The Technology* 
 \- You’ll get the chance to work with leading\-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.
   

  

***What You’ll Do***
* Analyzing debug log files and crash analysis, bug identification, suggesting fixes and coordinating with the engineering team to implement the bug fixes in future releases for MobiControl products
* Identifying MobiControl server\-side and client\-side limitations based on information gathered from the customer’s production environment
* Working with internal teams to develop, maintain, and update diagnostic tools internally to check configuration\-related issues and log files for multiple mobile platforms
* Troubleshooting, researching, and coordinating with frontline teams to evaluate the issue and narrow down the process/procedure or method that is causing the failure
* Identifying issues that are caused by the latest operating system or product updates, and coordinating with the engineering team to provide patches for fixing the issues


***Experience You’ll Bring:***
* Degree in Computer Information/Application Systems, Enterprise Computing, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
* Experience: Good to have experience in MDM or software development or related field (Exceptions apply)
* Well\-versed with enterprise MDM solutions and applications
* Knowledge and experience with various mobile platforms such as Android, Android Enterprise, and iOS
* Knowledgeable in Java/Android/Kotlin, C\#, .NET, and development platforms such as Android Studio, and Visual Studio
* Familiar with Git, software development, and the JIRA platform
* Familiar with Agile and project management
* Knowledgeable in SQL, Windows, and server management and administration
* Knowledgeable in networking concepts and various IT architectures and infrastructures
* Excellent critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with building custom applications for various use/business cases


 If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

title: Senior Engineer – Customer Support
description:
**Job Purpose**
 The Senior Engineer – Customer Support is responsible for delivering high\-quality technical support and
   

  

 field service for ROV systems delivered to the Clients. The role involves system commissioning,
   

  

 troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, customer training, warranty support, and onsite operational
   

  

 assistance. The position requires close coordination with Engineering, Production, and Quality teams to
   

  

 ensure maximum system availability, customer satisfaction, and continuous product improvement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Support \& Technical Service**
* Provide professional remote and onsite technical support for ROV systems, payloads, and


 associated equipment.
   

  

* Lead installation, commissioning, integration, and performance validation activities at customer


 sites.
   

  

* Support customer operations, onsite deployment support, sea trials, and technical


 demonstrations.
   

  

* Ensure timely response and effective resolution of customer technical issues.
* Act as the primary technical interface between customers and internal engineering teams.


**System Troubleshooting \& Maintenance**
* Perform systematic troubleshooting of ROV electrical, electronic, mechanical, communication,


 control, and software\-related issues.
   

  

* Execute preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and breakdown repair activities.

 actions.

 standards.

**Service Documentation \& Reporting**
* Prepare detailed service reports, commissioning reports, maintenance records, and warranty


 documentation.
   

  

* Maintain accurate records of customer issues, service history, and corrective actions.
* Provide field feedback and technical insights to Engineering and Product Development teams.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives based on customer feedback and field performance.


**Spare Parts \& Service Coordination**
* Analyze equipment failure trends and recommend spare parts requirements.
* Support service inventory management and spare parts planning.
* Coordinate with internal teams for replacement parts, technical solutions, and product updates.

* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Instrumentation, or


 related engineering disciplines.
   

  

* 2–5 years of experience in customer support, field service engineering, commissioning, or


 maintenance roles
 **.**
* Experience in marine technology, ROV systems, underwater robotics, automation, or industrial


 equipment is preferred.

**Technical Competencies** 
 :
   

  

* Strong knowledge of electrical and electronic systems.
* Hands\-on experience in troubleshooting power systems, control systems, sensors, actuators, and


 communication networks.
   

  

* Ability to interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Experience in system integration, testing, and commissioning.
* Knowledge of embedded systems, software interfaces, and industrial communication protocols.
* Ability to perform field diagnostics and repair activities independently.

* Strong customer focus and service\-oriented approach.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently in challenging field environments.
* Strong coordination and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to travel for customer support and offshore activities.

title: MS Exchange Administrator
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**MS Exchange Administrator**
 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 350,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Responsible for supporting and administering global Messaging and Directory services, with primary accountability for Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching, maintenance and related infrastructure activities.
   

  

 The role also requires working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange to support end\-to\-end service operations, troubleshooting and coordination across the messaging environment.
   

  

 This entails following ITIL methodologies and may include infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, migrations, vendor coordination, documentation, knowledge sharing and training of team members.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises administration and infrastructure support.
* Plan, coordinate and execute Microsoft Exchange Server On\-Premises patching activities, including Security Updates (SUs), Hotfix Updates (HUs), Cumulative Updates (CUs), Windows updates and required prerequisites.
* Review Microsoft security advisories, release notes, known issues, prerequisites and dependencies, and translate them into patch\-readiness assessments and implementation plans.
* Prepare Exchange servers for maintenance using approved procedures, including service health checks, Database Availability Group (DAG) and database validations, transport queue checks, load\-balancer coordination and server maintenance mode.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures and post\-patching issues using Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, PowerShell, HealthChecker output and other approved diagnostic tools.
* Create and manage change records, implementation plans, validation evidence, rollback plans, stakeholder communications and closure documentation in accordance with established change\-management processes.
* Coordinate patching across production and non\-production environments, including maintenance windows, shift coverage, technical bridge support, vendor engagement and escalation to Microsoft Support when required.
* Provide operational support for Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and escalation of cloud\-side issues.
* Share technical knowledge through operational documentation and classroom or hands\-on training.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong ownership of Exchange Server On\-Premises patching in large, business\-critical environments.
* Methodical approach to patch assessment, risk identification, dependency validation, implementation, validation and rollback planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills across Exchange Server, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, IIS, networking and load\-balancing dependencies.
* Ability to work effectively during critical maintenance windows, service\-impacting incidents and accelerated security\-patching activities.
* Strong attention to detail in change records, technical procedures, validation evidence, server inventories and compliance reporting.
* Ability to communicate technical risks, implementation status and service impact clearly to technical teams, service owners, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong teamwork, organization, prioritization and time\-management skills in a globally distributed and cross\-cultural environment.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to standardize patching processes and identify safe automation opportunities.
* Willingness to share knowledge and provide classroom or hands\-on training to team members.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Seven or more years of hands\-on experience in Microsoft Exchange Server administration, including recent experience with Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and/or Subscription Edition.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing Exchange Server On\-Premises patching across multiple servers, including SUs, HUs, CUs, Windows updates, prerequisites, reboot coordination and rollback readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Exchange maintenance mode, DAGs, database copy health, transport queues, mail\-flow validation, certificates, virtual directories and post\-patching verification.
* Proficiency in Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, remote health checks, validation, reporting and automation.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange, including recipient administration, connectors, accepted domains, mail flow, message tracing and Exchange Online PowerShell.
* Experience working within ITIL incident, problem and change\-management processes, including implementation planning, rollback planning, testing, evidence collection and closure.
* Experience supporting a large, highly available or geographically distributed Exchange environment and coordinating with infrastructure teams, monitoring teams, vendors and Microsoft Support.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, sound judgment, cross\-cultural awareness and effective stakeholder\-management skills.
* Flexibility to support planned maintenance, night shifts, weekends and critical security\-patching windows when required.


**Technical skills to include:**
* Microsoft Exchange Server 2016, 2019 and Subscription Edition administration and troubleshooting.
* Exchange Security Update, Hotfix Update, Cumulative Update and Windows patch deployment.
* Patch\-readiness assessment, maintenance mode, pre\-patching and post\-patching validation, and rollback planning.
* Exchange DAGs, databases, database copy health, transport services, mail\-flow components, connectors, certificates, namespaces and virtual directories.
* Exchange Management Shell and Windows PowerShell for administration, automation, reporting and remote server health validation.
* Exchange HealthChecker, Exchange setup and update logs, Windows event logs, SCOM or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Working knowledge of Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange administration, troubleshooting and mail flow.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with Exchange HealthChecker, SCOM or equivalent monitoring platforms, load balancers and enterprise vulnerability management tools.
* Knowledge of Exchange high availability, backup, disaster recovery, site resilience, email security, archiving and retention.
* Experience improving or automating patching workflows, compliance reporting and post\-patching validation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and compliance, Exchange Online Protection and Defender for Office 365\.
* Experience managing Exchange certificates, TLS configuration, namespaces and certificate\-renewal activities.
* Experience supporting Hybrid Configuration Wizard activities and troubleshooting hybrid mail flow and connectivity.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support during critical patching or service\-restoration activities.


**What We Look For**
* A technically strong Exchange On\-Premises administrator who can independently own patching activities from assessment and change planning through implementation, validation and evidence\-based closure.
* A reliable team member who works safely in a controlled enterprise environment, communicates risks early and collaborates effectively across global teams.
* Flexibility to work in night shifts or outside standard business hours when required for maintenance and critical security updates.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: TechOps-SAP-FICO-Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize design to meet business requirements.
   

  

 This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best\-in\-class solutions, automation and innovation.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* Bachelor’s degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* 10\-14 Years of experience required in one or more areas within SAP FICO preferably with Global client
* Deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM processes and methodology and how it interacts with the application lifecycle management principles
* Ability to manage cross functional and technical team, give them directions and drive functional and technical discussions with various stake holders
* Proven track record of successfully driving solutions in a complex, multi\-platform environment

* Depth of experience in setting up, growing, transforming, and delivering application management teams

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization
* Strong client management, analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to think strategically and make data driven decisions
* Responsible for providing support SAP FICO module incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Support incident solving by analyzing incidents raised by users and provides solutions.
* Working closely with customers and teams to ensure issues and requests are followed\-up and addressed timely.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of new business requirements.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions to make processes more efficient and simpler whenever possible.

* Defect resolution and defect analysis related to FICO.

* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements

**What you will do:**

* Lead and mentor the cross functional team fostering culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement

* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation
* Participate in on\-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client (AUSTRALIA, ASIA, Europe and AMERICAS hours)


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
